info.name: Transnova API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Transnova backend.

## Setup
1. Import this collection **and** the accompanying `transnova.postman_environment.json` environment file.
2. Select the **Transnova Local** environment in the top-right dropdown.
3. **Get a token** â€” run `[DEV] Firebase Signup` (first time) or `[DEV] Firebase Token` (existing user). The `idToken` is automatically saved to `{{firebaseToken}}`.
4. **Sync your profile** â€” run `Auth / Sync Profile` to create the user document in MongoDB.
5. Run any other endpoint â€” the `Authorization: Bearer {{firebaseToken}}` header is set on every protected request automatically.

item.name: Onramp

request.description:
Creates a pending on-ramp transaction and returns a Transak widget URL.

Prerequisites:
- User must have an active Circle USDC wallet (stored in {{circleWalletId}})
- SERVER .env must have CLIENT_ORIGIN set (e.g. http://localhost:3000)
- The Origin header must match CLIENT_ORIGIN exactly -- add {{clientOrigin}} env var

Body: { walletId (required), fiatCurrency? (3-letter, default: USD), fiatAmount (required, positive, max 1000000) }
Response: { transaction: {...}, widgetUrl: 'https://...' }

Receives Transak order status webhooks (no Firebase auth -- verified via HMAC JWT).

In production Transak calls this automatically. Use only for manual local simulation.

Status mappings (eventID -> app status):
  ORDER_CREATED -> pending
  ORDER_PAYMENT_VERIFYING -> processing
  ORDER_PROCESSING -> processing
  ORDER_COMPLETED -> completed
  ORDER_FAILED -> failed
  ORDER_REFUNDED -> cancelled
  ORDER_EXPIRED -> cancelled

item.name: Offramp
item.description:
Endpoints mounted at /api/v1/offramp.
Powered by the Crossmint integration.

request.description:
Creates a Crossmint off-ramp ACH payment method (US bank account).
Body: { type?, beneficiary: { name, email, address: { street1, city, state, postalCode, country? } }, bankAccount: { accountType?, routingNumber, accountNumber, bankName? } }

Creates a Crossmint off-ramp order to convert USDC to USD via ACH.
Body: { payerAddress (required), paymentMethodId (required), amount (required, positive), chain? (default: polygon-amoy), currency? (default: usdc) }
